acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-finish emits per-phase timings to its log.
The dominant phase is identified and either sped up or made resumable, with a retained before/after measurement on a docs-only change.
A docs-only lane finish runs under 600 s on a loaded host, or the remaining limit is recorded.
body: Observed 2026-10-17 (corvint origin/main 072a306f1, Go 1.27.2, host load about 60): in two builder lanes (evidence PR #1053 and the #1052 fix lane), `make dogfood-finish` ran longer than the 600 s Bash tool limit. The harness moved it to the background, and the agent parked without reporting. Expected: finish completes well under 10 minutes, or reports progress and phase timings so that a caller can bound it. Actual: one opaque step, over 600 s. Workaround: the lane charter now says to wait in the foreground.
title: make dogfood-finish routinely exceeds the 600 s agent tool timeout under host load 40-60, so builder lanes get backgrounded and park
